items.title: Minimum wage rises more than inflation in 'particularly challenging' decision
items.description: Australia's minimum wage will increase by 5.97 per cent, and minimum award workers will get a 4.75 per cent pay boost, in the Fair Work Commission's (FWC) annual wage review.

items.title: Live: Real pay for millions of workers is still catching up to 2021
items.description: Millions of workers will get the pay rise, after Fair Work raised modern award wages above the rate of inflation. Follow live.

items.title: This detective was told his colleagues were attacked. Then he saw the footage
items.description: As the footballer, shirt torn, face bloodied and with a concussion, paced his police cell, a veteran detective's phone started to ring.

items.title: Former wife of tobacco baron alleges horrific life entangled in illegal trade
items.description: After an arranged marriage to tobacco baron Sam Albion, Kawther Salih says the relationship spiralled into an abusive situation that saw her subjugated into working in the underground tobacco industry.

items.title: Visa applicants in the dark as migration law firm goes into liquidation
items.description: Gold Migration Lawyers went into liquidation yesterday, leaving customers out of pocket thousands of dollars and their visa applications unresolved.

items.title: What the polls reveal about One Nation's growing appeal
items.description: The One Nation leader, whose popularity has soared in the past 12 months, would be the first to say she doesn't put too much stock in the numbers.

items.title: Veteran broadcaster Alan Jones has one of charges against him dropped
items.description: Prosecutors drop one of the criminal charges against veteran broadcaster Alan Jones less than two months before the start of his trial, reducing the number of complainants in his indecent assault case.

items.title: Russian strike on Ukraine leaves multiple dead and others feared trapped
items.description: A major Russian attack on parts of Ukraine and its capital, Kyiv, has killed multiple people, damaged buildings and left others feared trapped under rubble, local authorities say.

items.title: Tax deduction red flags on the ATO's radar
items.description: The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) is warning Australians to stop claiming private expenses on their tax returns. The agency gives its tips this tax time, including the dos and don'ts of claiming work-related expenses and investment losses.

items.title: Live: One Nation's David Farley sworn in as Coalition resolves to vote against tax package
items.description: One Nation's David Farley has been sworn in as the MP for Farrer. Meanwhile, the Coalition has resolved to vote against the government's tax package. Follow live.

items.title: Media mogul Antony Catalano has bail varied to allow travel to Byron Bay
items.description: Former ACM executive Antony Catalano will be allowed to visit his wife and kids after successfully applying to have his bail conditions changed.

items.title: Mother shares incredible survival story after WA's strongest storm in 49 years
items.description: A driver says she almost died in a freak car accident on a highway in regional WA during Sunday's wild weather.

items.title: James Boag ends 145-year history as brewer ceases Tasmanian production
items.description: The famed northern Tasmanian brewer announces it will cease production in the state by November and repay a government loan it secured to keep its Launceston brewery visitor centre open.

items.title: Firefighters say they're left with 'what ifs' after fatal housefire
items.description: The United Firefighters Union says the only fire truck at the nearest station had already been called to a job, leading to a delayed response to a fire that killed a three-year-old boy.

items.title: Owning a dog was nothing like I'd imagined
items.description: I completely neglected to give much thought to whether my personality would slot into a dog's lifestyle. Spoiler — it did not.

items.title: Why make-up sex may not be fixing anything
items.description: Experts say if a fight keeps ending up in the bedroom, it could be a sign you and your partner aren't resolving anything.

items.title: Quiz: Are you smart enough to understand the Scripps Spelling Bee?
items.description: We don't think you'll have even heard of most of these words, let alone know how to spell them.

items.title: Quicksand causes terrifying ‘Indiana Jones moment’ for second Adelaide beachgoer
items.description: Days after a young Adelaide beachgoer had to be rescued from quicksand, a second person has spoken out about a similar experience along the same stretch of coast, saying she was momentarily overcome by "complete fear".

items.title: Potential buyers 'happy to pay $23 million' for Whitsundays island
items.description: A proposed resort and overwater gondola at a Whitsundays island is a step closer to becoming reality, after attracting expressions of interest from several possible buyers.

items.title: Neighbours complain about 200 chopper flights a week into luxury resort
items.description: A luxury resort that has been shut for three years hopes to reopen by chauffeuring guests down a steep 4WD track and flying them in on more than 200 helicopter flights a week.

items.title: Nurses told not to wear colourful scrubs at Hobart hospital
items.description: Nurses at the Royal Hobart Hospital have been told they should stop wearing fun scrubs or "free dress" and reminded they need to maintain "some professionalism" regarding their uniform.

items.title: Foran gets Manly's top job, Origin rep signs with two clubs in one day
items.description: Manly shows faith in Kieran Foran by appointing the ex-NRL star as its head coach through to the end of the 2029 season.

items.title: Twenty richest Australians hold more wealth than bottom 3 million households
items.description: Australia now has 178 billionaires who collectively hold more than $686 billion in wealth, sparking debate about the advantages and disadvantages of the growing number of ultra-wealthy.

items.title: How batteries muscled out gas and pushed power prices down
items.description: Fossil fuels, which have powered the global economy for centuries, are under threat. And Australia has become ground zero in this global battle.

items.title: Canberra's new hospital to be 'state-of-the art' — with extra parking
items.description: The ACT government unveils details of the new North Canberra Hospital as part of its latest budget, with the total cost of the project now expected to be $1.5 billion.
